series_description_long:
---
title: "The Stardust Engine: The Story of the Iron Five"
---
Step into the thirty-year story of [**The Stardust Engine**](https://stardust.raggiesoft.com), told in third-person limited narrative form from the perspective of lead guitarist **Ryan O'Connell**.

In the autumn of **1986**, inside a cold cinder-block garage on **Progress Street** in Blacksburg, Virginia, siblings **Ryan** and **Cassidy O'Connell** and their identical twin maternal cousins **Evan** and **Tyler Wright** wrote their very first song together at **Commonwealth Polytechnic Institute (CPI)**: [**"The Stardust Engine"**](https://music.raggiesoft.com/artists/the-stardust-engine/1987-electric-color?track=1-13-the-stardust-engine)—celebrating their shared love of the cosmos (**"Stardust"**) and the rockets to get you there (**"Engine"**), while sixteen-year-old youngest sister **Holly O'Connell** guarded their masters with her famous `$1.00` Perpetual Mutual Cross-License.

Across six chronological eras, follow Ryan from the 1980s college garages of Blacksburg and the corporate pop machinery of Apex Records, through the blinding snow of **Mile Marker 98** on December 10, 1990 that left him with a complete T10 spinal cord injury, the 1992 *Friction* walkout and the 1995 warehouse sessions where he yanked his own amplifier plug out of the wall to create the **Main Engine Cutoff** of Cassidy's magnum opus [**"Escape Velocity (Ad Astra)"**](https://music.raggiesoft.com/artists/the-stardust-engine/2016-live-at-the-crucible?track=escape-velocity-ad-astra-live-at-the-crucible) (known to fans simply as ***"Ad Astra"***), the quiet living-room sanctuary of [**Our Own Frequency**](https://music.raggiesoft.com/artists/the-stardust-engine/2008-our-own-frequency), and finally back home to the 65,000-seat bowl of **The Crucible** on **May 21, 2016** for [**Live at the Crucible**](https://music.raggiesoft.com/artists/the-stardust-engine/2016-live-at-the-crucible)—crossing paths with sophomore [**Jordan Fuller**](https://books.raggiesoft.com/aubrie/spring-semester-2016/live-at-the-crucible-senior-commencement) sitting down in `Section 104, Row A, Seat 1`.

### Companion Portals & Cross-Universe Links

* **Official Cosmic Band Portal (`stardust.raggiesoft.com`)**: Explore [**The Iron Five Dossiers**](https://stardust.raggiesoft.com/band), the [**64-Exhibit Deep Lore Archive**](https://stardust.raggiesoft.com/lore), the barrier-free [**Rolling Sanctuary Fleet**](https://stardust.raggiesoft.com/fleet) (*The Iron Horse* & the *Prairie Coachworks RLFD30*), and the [**Cosmic Novel Reader**](https://stardust.raggiesoft.com/novel).
* **The Listening Room (`music.raggiesoft.com`)**: Stream all 21 albums, live concert recordings, and archival compilations—including [**1987's *Electric Color***](https://music.raggiesoft.com/artists/the-stardust-engine/1987-electric-color), [**1997's *Hard Reset***](https://music.raggiesoft.com/artists/the-stardust-engine/1997-hard-reset), [**2008's *Our Own Frequency***](https://music.raggiesoft.com/artists/the-stardust-engine/2008-our-own-frequency), [**2016's *Live at the Crucible***](https://music.raggiesoft.com/artists/the-stardust-engine/2016-live-at-the-crucible), and [**2016's *The Forger's Call***](https://music.raggiesoft.com/artists/the-stardust-engine/2016-the-forgers-call)—in [**The Listening Room**](https://music.raggiesoft.com/artists/the-stardust-engine).
* **Companion CPI Campus Novel (*Before the Distance: The Story of John & Erin*)**: Read the complete 4-chapter companion story portrayed by Ryan and Cassidy at [**books.raggiesoft.com/erin**](https://books.raggiesoft.com/erin) alongside its [**curated soundtrack playlist**](https://music.raggiesoft.com/playlists/john-and-erin).
* **Dual-Perspective Concert Experience (*May 21, 2016 — Live at the Crucible*)**: Read **Book 6, Chapter 1** of this novel from **Ryan O'Connell's onstage perspective** side-by-side with **Jordan Fuller's front-row perspective** in `Section 104, Row A` in [**The Eleventh Child (`e007/c004`)**](https://books.raggiesoft.com/aubrie/spring-semester-2016/live-at-the-crucible-senior-commencement).

parts.part_title: Part 2: Act I: The Anvil Strike & The Marching Forgers
parts.location: Stage Left Wing to Center Stage, The Crucible, Commonwealth Polytechnic Institute, Blacksburg, VA
parts.image_alt: From the Section 104, Row A accessible terrace inside The Crucible at night, fans cheer up at a sweeping cinema camera jib overhead while on the main stage all 300 members of the CPI Marching Forgers perform alongside Ryan and Cassidy O'Connell under molten-orange and foundry-maroon spotlights.

images.alt: From the Section 104, Row A accessible terrace inside The Crucible at night, fans cheer up at a sweeping cinema camera jib overhead while on the main stage all 300 members of the CPI Marching Forgers perform alongside Ryan and Cassidy O'Connell under molten-orange and foundry-maroon spotlights.

On stage inside The Crucible during 'The Stardust Engine', Ryan O'Connell plays a soaring lead on his sunburst Les Paul electric guitar from his manual wheelchair on stage-left while Cassidy O'Connell sings and plays her wraparound analog synthesizer rig at center-right, backed by Evan Wright, Tyler Wright, and the 300 uniformed brass and percussionists of the CPI Marching Forgers under deep cosmic-violet nebula projections.

parts.part_title: Part 3: Act II: The Orbital Crew, Not Your Doll & Fifty-Two to Nothing
parts.location: Main Stage, The Crucible, Commonwealth Polytechnic Institute, Blacksburg, VA
parts.image_alt: Inside The Crucible at night during 'Fifty-Two to Nothing: The Norfolk Reckoning', massive glowing Foundry Maroon and Molten Orange numerals on the North End Zone scoreboard display 'CPI 52 — VDU 0' while down on the Section 104, Row A accessible terrace, fans cheer wildly.

images.alt: Inside The Crucible at night during 'Fifty-Two to Nothing: The Norfolk Reckoning', massive glowing Foundry Maroon and Molten Orange numerals on the North End Zone scoreboard display 'CPI 52 — VDU 0' while down on the Section 104, Row A accessible terrace, fans cheer wildly.

Cassidy O'Connell stands fiercely at the front edge of The Crucible stadium stage in a black leather jacket over a maroon CPI Alumni shirt, gripping a tilted microphone stand and belting 'Not Your Doll' while Ryan O'Connell shreds on his sunburst electric guitar from his manual wheelchair beside her and crimson pyrotechnics erupt behind them.

parts.part_title: Part 4: Acts III & IV: Ad Astra, Cosmic Tidal Lock & Mile Marker 98

parts.image_alt: Cassidy O'Connell stands front and center at the edge of The Crucible stadium stage singing 'Escape Velocity (Ad Astra)' with soaring emotion while Ryan O'Connell plays a zero-gravity solo on his sunburst electric guitar from his manual wheelchair to her left, backed by a 120-foot curved LED screen and 65,000 synchronized LED wristbands glowing in the crimson reds, sapphire blues, ultraviolet purples, and solar gold of a deep-space nebula.

images.alt: Cassidy O'Connell stands front and center at the edge of The Crucible stadium stage singing 'Escape Velocity (Ad Astra)' with soaring emotion while Ryan O'Connell plays a zero-gravity solo on his sunburst electric guitar from his manual wheelchair to her left, backed by a 120-foot curved LED screen and 65,000 synchronized LED wristbands glowing in the crimson reds, sapphire blues, ultraviolet purples, and solar gold of a deep-space nebula.

During 'Moon 2: Roche Limit' inside The Crucible, Ryan O'Connell sits front and center in his manual wheelchair playing an aggressive riff on his sunburst Les Paul electric guitar while Cassidy O'Connell plays her synthesizer rig behind him and the 120-foot curved LED screen displays a fracturing moon glowing with molten-gold and crimson fissures under emergency crimson planetarium lasers.

parts.image_alt: Under two solitary warm golden spotlights at center stage inside the darkened 65,000-seat bowl of The Crucible, Ryan O'Connell sits in his manual wheelchair fingerpicking an acoustic guitar beside his sister Cassidy O'Connell at a gleaming black grand piano during 'Brother's Keeper', while the curved stage screen behind them displays 'THE FORGER NATION SUMMER FESTIVAL • AUGUST 2017' and thousands of fans hold up quiet white lights across the stands.

images.alt: Under two solitary warm golden spotlights at center stage inside the darkened 65,000-seat bowl of The Crucible, Ryan O'Connell sits in his manual wheelchair fingerpicking an acoustic guitar beside his sister Cassidy O'Connell at a gleaming black grand piano during 'Brother's Keeper', while the curved stage screen behind them displays 'THE FORGER NATION SUMMER FESTIVAL • AUGUST 2017' and thousands of fans hold up quiet white lights across the stands.

During the romantic 1987 piano ballad 'My Anchor Holds' inside The Crucible bathed in warm candlelight gold and starlight white, fans in Section 104, Row A hold each other close along the terrace railing.

At 10:50 PM outside the illuminated Gothic limestone arches of The Crucible at the Crucible Bus Loop, white-and-maroon Blue Ridge Transit articulated shuttles displaying 'CBURG TRANS CTR' / 'GO FORGERS!' on their amber LED destination signs board students and alumni for the ride home.
